# SCP-457 Containment
By default, SCP-457 spawns in its containment chamber, which restricts its movement and prevents it from leaving. The containment chamber is a security measure that keeps the object safely contained.
[textlink="General information about the Burning Man" link="Scp457About"]
[textlink="More about escaping as the Burning Man" link="Scp457ContainmentBreach"]
## What Should You Do?
The object's primary method of breaching containment is to escape through the ventilation system. The Burning Man gains this ability upon reaching its small state.
[textlink="More about abilities" link="Scp457Abilities"]
Keep in mind that fully dying down takes 12 minutes. This gives personnel time to prepare at the start of the round.
The personnel's task is to keep the Burning Man in its medium state. To do so, periodically adjust its size by supplying fuel through the fuel dispenser.
Place the required amount of paper or wood into the fuel dispenser and activate it to transfer the items into SCP-457's containment chamber.
Do not add too many items, or SCP-457 will grow too large and become able to destroy the containment chamber!
[textlink="More about states" link="Scp457States"]
## What Should You Do if the Object Escapes?
Standard fire extinguishers and fire suits can be found throughout the facility. This equipment is more than enough to suppress SCP-457.
Gather a group of three people and find SCP-457. Search places that are likely to contain the most fuel, such as the D-Block library or the Head of Personnel's office.
Spray it until it is reduced to ash, then return it to its containment chamber. The object will regenerate on its own and begin burning again.
Keep in mind that subduing the object requires considerable force. A single person armed with a fire extinguisher will not be enough!
